page_title: FIO 1-0 TOR | Fiorentina v Torino 29/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
89' Koffi Djidji (Torino) has tested the patience of referee Federico La Penna and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
88' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Lucas Martinez Quarta (Fiorentina) replacing Giacomo Bonaventura.
87' Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina) receives a yellow card.
87' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) comes onto the pitch so that Jonathan Ikone can be given a rest.
87' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Adrien Tameze walks off the pitch to be replaced by Demba Seck (Torino).
83' 1 - 0 Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) heads the ball inside the left post after a splendid cross. This timely header produces a wonderful moment.
83' Fiorentina can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
81' Good work from Fiorentina as they win a corner.
79' Ivan Juric has decided to make a change. Mergim Vojvoda (Torino) replaces Raoul Bellanova.
78' We are about to witness a substitution. Koffi Djidji (Torino) is replacing Nikola Vlasic.
78' It's time for a substitution. Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) comes on in place of Cristiano Biraghi.
76' Karol Linetty (Torino) takes a direct free kick.
75' Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
75' Neat passing move from Torino in order to create new attacking opportunities.
68' Federico La Penna shows a yellow card to Michael Kayode (Fiorentina) for his blatant foul.
65' Vincenzo Italiano decides to make a substitution. Lucas Beltran will be replaced by M'Bala Nzola (Fiorentina).
64' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Arthur Melo departs the field of play to be replaced by Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina).
62' Samuele Ricci comes off the pitch to be replaced by Karol Linetty (Torino).
62' That will be all from Pietro Pellegri who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Antonio Sanabria (Torino).
58' The Fiorentina players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
56' What a wasted chance that is! An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Christian Kouame (Fiorentina) who sends his header well wide of the left post.
55' Arthur Melo (Fiorentina) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
55' Yellow card. Samuele Ricci (Torino) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
54' Fiorentina are ruled offside.
53' Alfred Duncan (Fiorentina) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
52' The resulting corner from Valentino Lazaro (Torino) is cleared.
50' Duvan Zapata (Torino) is flagged for offside.
48' Torino keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
48' Federico La Penna blows his whistle. Giacomo Bonaventura (Fiorentina) commits a foul after dangerous play.
46' The second half has just started.
45+1' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) touches the ball with his hand.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Lovely run from Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina). He finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper, lines up a shot, but the keeper boldly launches himself to intercept the ball.
42' Giacomo Bonaventura (Fiorentina) rises above the defence inside the box to power a fine header, but the goalkeeper is lucky as the ball flies narrowly wide of the right post.
42' Torino seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
41' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
40' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
37' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) receives a pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it towards the left post. Unfortunately for him, Pietro Terracciano makes a great save to stop his effort.
35' Samuele Ricci (Torino) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
34' Alessandro Buongiorno (Torino) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
31' A quickly taken corner by Fiorentina.
29' Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Federico La Penna who sees an offensive foul.
28' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
27' Raoul Bellanova (Torino) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.

25' Duvan Zapata (Torino) latches onto a precise lofted pass into the penalty area and produces a header at goal, but his attempt to the middle of the target fails to beat Pietro Terracciano, who makes a sensational save.
25' Ivan Ilic (Torino) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
24' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
23' Flag goes up against Duvan Zapata (Torino) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
23' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Duvan Zapata (Torino), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the left post.
22' Federico La Penna couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Pietro Pellegri (Torino) and blew his whistle.
21' Raoul Bellanova (Torino) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
20' This shall not pass! Nikola Milenkovic (Fiorentina) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
20' The free kick will be taken by Arthur Melo (Fiorentina).
18' Samuele Ricci (Torino) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
17' Pietro Pellegri (Torino) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Federico La Penna has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
14' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Federico La Penna blows his whistle for a foul.
13' Federico La Penna interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina).
12' Ivan Ilic (Torino) decides to speed play up by quickly sending the free kick into the box.
11' Pietro Pellegri (Torino) sprays a pass out to Nikola Vlasic, but he can't beat his man inside the box.
11' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) finds Pietro Pellegri with a nice pass so he can go on towards the goal.
9' The ball is cleared after Christian Kouame (Fiorentina) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
8' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) and Pietro Pellegri combine well with a quick one-two and their attacking move continues.
7' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Torino.
6' Ivan Ilic (Torino) stands over the resultant free kick from mid-range, but his shot goes just over the crossbar. It could have been a fantastic goal!
5' Ivan Ilic (Torino) will take a free kick. Is he going to strike the ball directly at the goal? Let's find out!
5' Nikola Milenkovic (Fiorentina) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle. Torino win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
3' A cross into the box from Raoul Bellanova (Torino) is cleared.
2' Nikola Vlasic latches onto a perfect defence-splitting pass from Samuele Ricci (Torino) and heads towards goal.

1' Pietro Pellegri (Torino) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Pietro Terracciano, who pulls off a comfortable save!
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Torino will kick-off.
Federico La Penna will officiate today.
